note: Onimusha: Way of the Sword. Every name of signals.json stays declared and reads 0 (no fcParams, no Wilds face bones); these entries wire names to Onimusha face_joint bones (translation only, in the Head's frame: +x = the face's left, +y up, +z forward). Measured on kevin's probe recordings 2026-10-14 (3-min idle, Musashi talking, a boss fight; Onimusha/work/probes): rest_mm = idle median, full_mm = travel to the 1st/99th percentile.

signals.name: eyeClose.L
signals.note: 骨骼：左上眼睑下移闭眼。游戏眨眼约 8.7mm（3 段录像的 1%）
signals.note_en: bone: left upper lid down (eye closes). A game blink travels about 8.7 mm (1st percentile of 3 recordings)

signals.name: eyeClose.R
signals.note: 骨骼：右上眼睑下移闭眼。约 7.5mm
signals.note_en: bone: right upper lid down (eye closes). About 7.5 mm

signals.name: eyeWiden.L
signals.note: 骨骼：左上眼睑比待机更高（睁大眼）。约 2.8mm
signals.note_en: bone: left upper lid above idle (eyes wide). About 2.8 mm

signals.name: eyeWiden.R
signals.note: 骨骼：右上眼睑比待机更高（睁大眼）。约 3.0mm
signals.note_en: bone: right upper lid above idle (eyes wide). About 3.0 mm

signals.note_en: bone: right lower lid rises. About 3.9 mm
